audit.whatIsWrong: diff read EVEN while diffRating was 8.5/10, tone was the red band, and report[14] said 'Hard matchup'. The page contradicted its own label.
audit.why: 49.19% over 929 games with a 9.5/10 carry threat and Gwen owning four of seven chart rows is not an even lane. Every other field on the page already said HARD.
audit.corrected: diff set to HARD to match the rating, the tone colour and report[14].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three level-chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the content layer's own whys. win[0] said Gwen while whys[0] says 'neither of us can commit'; win[1] said Gwen while whys[1] says 'Still even at level 2... the trade is a wash'; win[3] said Skill while whys[3] says 'She controls the 4-5 window'.
audit.why: Gwen's spike is Hallowed Mist at 3 and everything after it, not level 1-2 where she is genuinely weak. The packet chart (Skill, Skill, Gwen, Gwen, Gwen, Gwen, K'Sante) matches the prose exactly.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 flipped to Skill and row 3 to Gwen as matched full/content pairs, with ratings adjusted and the why text rewritten to state the mechanism.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) Needlework is described as a SNARE in four places ('her R Needlework snares', 'against her snares'). Riot's text: it 'hurls a needle that slows enemies hit'. It is a slow, not a root — a player who thinks he is snared will burn Flash he did not need to. (2) The full layer tells you fourteen times to fight 'off her mist' and never once says the thing that makes the mist beatable: Hallowed Mist only protects her from enemies OUTSIDE it, so Path Maker or Footwork carries you inside and she becomes targetable again. The packet's own defect line flags zero cooldown-sequencing cues on this page, and no Gwen cooldown appears anywhere.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s — the longest thing in her kit and genuinely worth waiting out, which only becomes actionable once the number is on the page. Skip 'n Slash is 13s at rank 1 but partially refunded when she connects, so it is baited rather than counted. And her Q deals TRUE damage in the centre, which is why the page's headline advice to 'build MR' is half wrong.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 I keep banking small leads with my bulk, trading around her cooldowns, but at 6 the lane tilts to her. Her R Needlework snares and pokes me from outside my short Q-W range, and the moment I commit a W charge she drops Hallowed Mist on herself — my dash whiffs, my Q3 finds nothing, and she chips my low-econ HP bar with Q true damage. All Out gives me a 1v1 against most bruisers, but against Gwen it strips my tankiness right when her mist and snares deny the duel, so I don't blindly ult a healthy Gwen sitting in her mist. Bait the mist or fight her when she's stepped off it.

notes: Three things worth the user's attention. (1) The page labelled this EVEN while its own rating said 8.5/10, its tone was red and report[14] said 'Hard matchup' — the label was the only field out of step. (2) Needlework was called a SNARE in four places; Riot's text gives it a slow. That matters because a player who believes he is rooted burns Flash. (3) The full layer repeats 'fight her off her mist' fourteen times and never states the interaction that makes it winnable — Hallowed Mist only blocks targeting from OUTSIDE, so Path Maker or Footwork puts you inside it and she is targetable again. The packet scored this page at zero cooldown-sequencing cues; it now carries Hallowed Mist at 22/21/20/19/18s and Skip 'n Slash's on-hit refund. The full layer also refers to Gwen as 'he'/'his' in roughly ten boilerplate strings (breakdown.feeding, report[8], report[12], dontsFull[2].d); I fixed the ones I was already rewriting and left the rest rather than churn low-value strings.
